package.description: Zero-click clipboard manager for Windows that lives on the left screen edge.

en-US.description: Zero-click clipboard manager for Windows that lives on the left screen edge.
en-US.longDescription: Trace is a Windows-only clipboard manager that lives on the left edge of your screen and expands on hover. It provides a zero-click panel, native OLE drag & drop to any desktop application, a task layer, and an AI suggestion pipeline.
en-US.name: Trace
